Veterans Benefits: Massachusetts fully excludes U.S. military retirement pensions from state gross income. Eligible veterans may also qualify for local property-tax exemptions based on service-connected disability or qualifying service, with additional municipal options under current Massachusetts law.
Description: Waltham is a Route 128 tech and biotech corridor city just west of Boston, home to Bentley University and Brandeis University and a significant RTX (Raytheon) corporate office that remained after the company's 2026 global headquarters relocation to Virginia. Crime rates vary widely by neighborhood, and housing costs run well above the national median.
